items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He was the greatest thing that happened to me. Because he told me so much about music.

ctx.x: He was the greatest thing that happened to me. Because he told me so much about music. Because he was the one who told me that... He told the band. He said, "Listen. The band is accompanying the singer." So that means you're supposed to be under the singer. He said, "You ain't never supposed to be louder than a singer." And he wrote music... We had never played that kind of music before.
